title: The Empirical Dad
author: The Empirical Dad
subtitle: Evidence-based parenting for dads who don't plan to slow down.
description: Evidence-based parenting for dads who don't plan to slow down. A daily briefing from the first positive test to age three, numbered by the day of pregnancy the way your OB counts it. Every claim is graded out loud as established, strong or emerging, and every risk gets a real number. One angle a day (body, brain, physiology, parents, adventure, protocol, myths) and one small action at the end. A personal research briefing, not medical advice.
disclaimer: The Empirical Dad is a personal research briefing, not medical advice. Decisions about pregnancy, birth and infant care belong with your OB, midwife and pediatrician.
